attributes.additional_details: If the lanes are clear and your sat in the middle lane you deserve 6 points. The congestion on motorways is becoming ridiculous and a big part of this is middle lane hogging
attributes.background: Give 6 points to people who hog the middle name on motorways when left lanes clear. It’s become a worse problem over the previous 2 years

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.

Decisions about whether to put penalty points on someone's licence are a matter for the courts, not the UK Government or Parliament. The courts can fine you and ‘endorse’ your driving record with penalty points if you’re convicted of a motoring offence, such as careless driving.

Unnecessarily driving in the middle lane may be considered careless driving. Careless driving can result in penalties from 3 to 9 penalty points, decided on by the court.

You may be interested in this petition: "Review traffic policing priorities, powers and resource allocation" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774976
